findings.claim: Entering a value with a comma instead of a period (e.g. "1,5" instead of "1.5") may not be handled correctly; the existing Safe-level Spending Limits feature casts a comma to a period, so this input handling should be checked for consistency.
The added dialogs are not responsive on smaller screens.
The file copy.ts is not descriptively named and should be renamed to something clearer, such as describeSpendingLimits.ts or policyCopy.ts.
